name: Repost Radar
summary: Finds uncredited reposts of your videos, clips and jokes across TikTok, Shorts, Instagram, Facebook, X and Reddit, logs proof in Notion and drafts claims.
summary_zh: 在 TikTok、YouTube Shorts、Instagram、Facebook、X 和 Reddit 上找出未署名转载你视频、片段和段子的帖子，在 Notion 存证并起草署名请求或版权申诉，由你决定。
